description: This file defines REST API routes for a backend application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for health checks, user authentication (register/login), user profile retrieval, store and product listing, shopping cart management, order creation and listing. The code interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM and references various models and schemas specific to the project.

methods.name: CartOut _calc_cart(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Calculates the contents and subtotal of a user's shopping cart by querying cart items and associated product data.
